name: init
long:
git init creates an empty Git repository.
It sets up the .git directory with all metadata.

name: init
long: echo "Hello, World!" > readme.txt creates a local file with the content "Hello, World!".

name: git add
long:
git add readme.txt adds the file to the staging area.
It prepares the file for the next commit.

name: git commit
long:
git commit -m "Add readme.txt" commits the changes to the repository.
It creates a new commit with the message "Add readme.txt".

name: git log
long:
This is a readonly command, It does not make any changes to files
in work areas or repositories.
git log shows the commit history.
It displays the commit history in a tree format.
